Title: TFGTRS-4352 - Hreflang cluster on Hobbs: single en to ROW, x-default to ROW, no raw SFCC links
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Open the Hobbs home page.
2. View the page source and search for hreflang.
3. Check each alternate link and open every URL.
Expected: There is one single "en" entry pointing to ROW and an x-default entry pointing to ROW. No link uses a raw SFCC domain (demandware.net). Every URL in the cluster returns 200 and has no noindex.
